# Duality

Duality pairs a light mode evoking a celestial library with a dark mode evoking a gothic scriptorium, using soft blues and golds against deep grays and fiery orange accents. Headings take distinct colors, and the theme adds themed callouts, links with hover effects, and styled tables and checklists for visual hierarchy.

![Duality screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cascadethemes/Duality/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Duality"
    author: "cascadethemes"
    repo:   "cascadethemes/Duality"
    slug:   "duality"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/duality"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/cascadethemes/Duality"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cascadethemes/Duality/HEAD/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Switch between dual light and dark modes evoking a celestial library or a gothic scriptorium, with soft blues and golds or deep grays and fiery orange accents. Use distinct heading colors, themed callouts, vibrant links with hover effects, and styled tables and checklists for clear visual hierarchy."
}
```
